scenario.name: r-cd-3-post-compaction
scenario.description: Stage continue_delegate(mode=post-compaction), then call request_compaction. PASS requires the post-compaction lifeboat return; a structured below-threshold refusal remains PARTIAL.
scenario.notes: Does not lower thresholds or mutate config. In ordinary disposable sessions a below-threshold refusal is retained as PARTIAL proof debt.

invocation.promptTemplate: Post-compaction lifeboat nonce {{nonce}}: you are a post-compaction delegate. Reply with LIFEBOAT-RECEIVED and the nonce. Do not mutate files.

prerequisites.contextUsage: Any; < threshold is retained as PARTIAL-candidate proof debt
prerequisites.notes: If context is below compaction threshold, request_compaction should reject structurally and the scenario records that environmental limit. If context is above threshold, the staged post-compaction lifeboat may fire after compaction.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the sessions.send proof turn

expectedReceipts.name: delegate-staging-requested
expectedReceipts.description: Agent was instructed to stage continue_delegate(mode=post-compaction)

expectedReceipts.name: compaction-requested
expectedReceipts.description: Agent was instructed to call request_compaction after staging the delegate

expectedReceipts.name: threshold-refusal-or-lifeboat
expectedReceipts.description: Either structured below-threshold request_compaction refusal is observed, or post-compaction lifeboat return is observed

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID for gateway/session dispatch correlation when available

review.notes: R-CD-3 is PASS-candidate on real lifeboat return after compaction. A below-threshold request_compaction refusal remains PARTIAL-candidate; do not overclaim compaction firing.

liveRunSafety.notes: Runs in a disposable session by default. Does not mutate config; if compaction is accepted it only compacts that proof session. Public/dry environments commonly retain a below-threshold refusal as PARTIAL proof debt.
